question: Study all genes expressed in salivary gland according to HPA consensus RNA data. Report the cohort size, counts by RNA tissue specificity category, the number of FDA approved drug targets and counts measured by blood immunoassay, by mass spectrometry, by both and by neither. Among cohort genes secreted to blood, rank twelve by log2((salivary gland nTPM+1)/(liver nTPM+1)), ties by Ensembl ID. Give their consensus nTPM in salivary gland, liver, pancreas and kidney, their specificity categories and the available blood concentrations. Draw a specificity-category bar chart, a blood-assay-coverage chart and the four-tissue heatmap; provide the tables. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

tool_uses.name: search_by_tissue
tool_uses.input: {"tissue": "salivary gland", "maxResults": 10000, "columns": "[\"Gene\", \"Ensembl\", \"Gene description\", \"Protein class\", \"RNA tissue specificity\", \"Protein evidence\"]"}

tool_uses.input: {"query": "", "tissueSpecific": "salivary gland", "maxResults": 10000, "columns": ["Gene", "Ensembl", "RNA tissue specificity", "RNA tissue distribution", "Protein class"]}

turns.text:
# Salivary‑gland cohort analysis — results and what the tools could not return

## 1. Critical data-availability finding (affects every requested number)

Across every tool call, **the HPA consensus RNA tissue panel provided by these tools contains 17 tissues and does NOT include salivary gland**:
`adipose tissue, adrenal gland, breast, colon, heart muscle, kidney, liver, lung, ovary, pancreas, prostate, skeletal muscle, skin 1, spleen, stomach 1, testis, thyroid gland` (verified in `get_tissue_expression`/`compare_expression_profiles` for CEACAM1, CA3, CST3, PLG, HTN1, MUC7, KLK1).

Consequences:
- There is **no "Tissue RNA – salivary gland [nTPM]" column** in any returned record, so the ranking `log2((salivary nTPM+1)/(liver nTPM+1))` **cannot be computed** for any gene. No qualifying member can be verified → **0 eligible members**; per your rule, the returned list is empty (count = 0) rather than a fabricated ranking.
- A per-gene RNA tissue **specificity category** ("Tissue enriched/enhanced…" etc.) was **not returned by the salivary-gland search endpoint** for cohort members, so cohort-level category counts are not determinable (only per-gene values for the handful of genes I individually queried, in §4).

The only cohort-like data returned was from `search_by_tissue(tissue="salivary gland")` per expression level. These lists are the basis for the counts below. Note they are internally inconsistent (5 genes appear in two level buckets), so treat as tool-provided subsets, not a clean specificity partition.

## 2. Cohort as delivered by the tools

| Expression-level bucket (tool-reported) | Count |
|---|---|
| High | 30 |
| Medium | 2 |
| Low | 17 (5 duplicated from "High": BMP7, CA3, CACNA1S, ANK1, TOM1L2) |
| Not detected | 1 (CEACAM1) |

**Unique genes with salivary-gland expression reported: 44** (union of high/medium/low), **45 including the not-detected CEACAM1 (ENSG00000079385)**.

Full 44-gene list (Gene — Ensembl; * = appears in two level buckets):
BMP7 (ENSG00000101144)*, PRKAR1A (ENSG00000108946), CSH2 (ENSG00000213218), SLC26A9 (ENSG00000174502), MUC16 (ENSG00000181143), CST3 (ENSG00000101439), CCN5 (ENSG00000064205), CA3 (ENSG00000164879)*, BMAL1 (ENSG00000133794), DAG1 (ENSG00000173402), VTN (ENSG00000109072), TIMP1 (ENSG00000102265), MSN (ENSG00000147065), CACNA1S (ENSG00000081248)*, GNB1 (ENSG00000078369), GH1 (ENSG00000259384), AGFG2 (ENSG00000106351), ACSL5 (ENSG00000197142), HSPA4L (ENSG00000164070), PSMD4 (ENSG00000159352), ACAN (ENSG00000157766), CDH22 (ENSG00000149654), TUFT1 (ENSG00000143367), FABP4 (ENSG00000170323), GCNT3 (ENSG00000140297), SULT1A2 (ENSG00000197165), ANK1 (ENSG00000029534)*, HTR7 (ENSG00000148680), TOM1L2 (ENSG00000175662)*, RASSF6 (ENSG00000169435), GLYATL2 (ENSG00000156689), ALDH3A1 (ENSG00000108602), FGF8 (ENSG00000107831), HAND2 (ENSG00000164107), SIX1 (ENSG00000126778), MEF2C (ENSG00000081189), TGFB2 (ENSG00000092969), HGF (ENSG00000019991), F2 (ENSG00000180210), LIPA (ENSG00000107798), SKIL (ENSG00000136603), MOCOS (ENSG00000075643), SMPD3 (ENSG00000103056), P2RY13 (ENSG00000181631).

## 3. Requested counts

| Metric | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Cohort size (detected) | **44** (+1 not detected: CEACAM1) | from tool lists |
| Counts by RNA tissue specificity category | **not determinable** — field not returned for cohort members | see caveat §1 |
| FDA-approved drug targets in cohort | **4**: **CA3, CACNA1S, F2, HTR7** | from "Protein class" in search results |
| Measured by blood immunoassay (IM) | **0 confirmed** (no IM value returned for any cohort gene) | |
| Measured by mass spectrometry (MS) | **1**: CA3 (30,000,000 pg/L) | from Ensembl record for CA3 |
| By both IM and MS | **0 confirmed** | |
| By neither | 43 (unreported in returned data — not asserted as truly unmeasured) | |

## 1. Critical data-availability finding (affects every requested number)

Across every tool call, **the HPA consensus RNA tissue panel provided by these tools contains 17 tissues and does NOT include salivary gland**:
`adipose tissue, adrenal gland, breast, colon, heart muscle, kidney, liver, lung, ovary, pancreas, prostate, skeletal muscle, skin 1, spleen, stomach 1, testis, thyroid gland` (verified in `get_tissue_expression`/`compare_expression_profiles` for CEACAM1, CA3, CST3, PLG, HTN1, MUC7, KLK1).

Consequences:
- There is **no "Tissue RNA – salivary gland [nTPM]" column** in any returned record, so the ranking `log2((salivary nTPM+1)/(liver nTPM+1))` **cannot be computed** for any gene. No qualifying member can be verified → **0 eligible members**; per your rule, the returned list is empty (count = 0) rather than a fabricated ranking.
- A per-gene RNA tissue **specificity category** ("Tissue enriched/enhanced…" etc.) was **not returned by the salivary-gland search endpoint** for cohort members, so cohort-level category counts are not determinable (only per-gene values for the handful of genes I individually queried, in §4).

The only cohort-like data returned was from `search_by_tissue(tissue="salivary gland")` per expression level. These lists are the basis for the counts below. Note they are internally inconsistent (5 genes appear in two level buckets), so treat as tool-provided subsets, not a clean specificity partition.

## 6. Bottom line
- **Cohort as returned: 44 genes detected (+1 not detected). FDA-approved targets: 4 (CA3, CACNA1S, F2, HTR7). Blood assays: 1 MS-only (CA3, 3.0×10⁷ pg/L); 0 IM; 0 both.**
- **The requested top-12 salivary-vs-liver ranking has 0 eligible members** because no salivary-gland nTPM values were returned by any tool (salivary gland is absent from the consensus RNA tissue panel provided). I have not estimated or imputed any values.
- Cohort-level specificity-category counts are not determinable from the available tools (the search endpoint did not return the specificity-category field, and the per-level buckets contain 5 duplicated genes).
